CREATE FUNCTION population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_pbt_reviewed_source_v1()
RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY INVOKER SET search_path='pg_catalog' AS $pbt$
DECLARE original text; v_output_text text; v_output jsonb; checks_pass boolean; positions integer; nulls integer;
BEGIN
original:=population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_shared_body_v1('financial-document-v1:2d77c05a46850b1af8420da0432f12b1177eeade417a16606827d622161736a1');
SELECT details#>>'{private_candidate_files,private_output.json}' INTO STRICT v_output_text
FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_event
WHERE event_id=156481 AND event='PBT_EXACT_HTML_CANDIDATE_QUALIFICATION_V1'
AND details->>'approved'='true' AND details->>'reviewer' IS DISTINCT FROM details->>'producer'
AND details->>'review_scope'='EXACT_PRIVATE_CANDIDATE_QUALIFICATION_ONLY';
IF v_output_text IS NULL OR encode(sha256(convert_to(v_output_text,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM '7d14aa7fdf06210e11b205d5dbc725818e4a616cabcedb8ab90802b7e3a3bff0'
OR octet_length(original) IS DISTINCT FROM 654131 OR encode(sha256(convert_to(original,'UTF8')),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM 'b9a804fd92f10c02692db9afe52ba11626ca19b5f57e54dba5efe62d5bdac788'
THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PBT_REVIEWED_SOURCE_OUTPUT_PIN_CHANGED';END IF;
v_output:=v_output_text::jsonb;
IF v_output->>'accounting_basis' IS DISTINCT FROM 'MODIFIED_CASH_NON_GAAP_ROYALTY_TRUST' OR v_output->'family_accepted' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PBT_QUALIFICATION_CHANGED';END IF;
WITH variants AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 'actual'::text case_name,original body,v_output output,v_output_text output_text),
facts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT v.*,f,ord, (f->>'table_ordinal')::int tab,(f->>'row_ordinal')::int rownum,
 (f->>'column_ordinal')::int col,
 replace(replace(regexp_replace(f#>>'{value_cell,raw_html}','<[^>]*>','','g'),'—','—'),' ','') cell_text,
 replace(regexp_replace(f#>>'{suffix_cell,raw_html}','<[^>]*>','','g'),' ','') suffix_text
 FROM variants v CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(v.output->'facts') WITH ORDINALITY j(f,ord)
), checked AS (
 SELECT *,
 (encode(sha256(convert_to(body,'UTF8')),'hex')='b9a804fd92f10c02692db9afe52ba11626ca19b5f57e54dba5efe62d5bdac788' AND octet_length(body)=654131) source_ok,
 output=output_text::jsonb AND encode(sha256(convert_to(output_text,'UTF8')),'hex')='7d14aa7fdf06210e11b205d5dbc725818e4a616cabcedb8ab90802b7e3a3bff0' output_pin_ok,
 (substring(body FROM (f#>>'{value_cell,source_character_start}')::int+1 FOR (f#>>'{value_cell,source_character_end_exclusive}')::int-(f#>>'{value_cell,source_character_start}')::int)=f#>>'{value_cell,raw_html}'
 AND substring(body FROM (f#>>'{suffix_cell,source_character_start}')::int+1 FOR (f#>>'{suffix_cell,source_character_end_exclusive}')::int-(f#>>'{suffix_cell,source_character_start}')::int)=f#>>'{suffix_cell,raw_html}') offsets_ok,
 (encode(sha256(convert_to(f#>>'{value_cell,raw_html}','UTF8')),'hex')=f#>>'{value_cell,raw_html_sha256}'
 AND encode(sha256(convert_to(f#>>'{suffix_cell,raw_html}','UTF8')),'hex')=f#>>'{suffix_cell,raw_html_sha256}') cell_hashes_ok,
 btrim(cell_text)=f->>'source_value' AND btrim(suffix_text)=f->>'source_suffix' lexical_ok,
 CASE WHEN cell_text='—' THEN f->'value'='null'::jsonb AND f->>'state'='NULL_DASH'
 ELSE f->>'state'='NUMERIC' AND (f->>'value')::numeric = replace(replace(cell_text,',',''),'(','')::numeric * CASE WHEN cell_text LIKE '(%' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END END numeric_ok,
 CASE WHEN tab=9 AND rownum IN(3,7) THEN f->>'period_kind'='INSTANT' AND f->'period_start'='null'::jsonb
 AND f->>'period_boundary'=CASE WHEN rownum=3 THEN 'OPENING_OF_REPORTED_QUARTER' ELSE 'CLOSING_OF_REPORTED_QUARTER' END
 AND f->>'period_date_basis'='DERIVED_REPORTED_QUARTER_BOUNDARY'
 AND f->>'period_end'=(CASE WHEN col=1 THEN '2026' ELSE '2025' END)||CASE WHEN rownum=3 THEN '-01-01' ELSE '-03-31' END
 ELSE true END balance_period_ok,
 f->>'unit'=CASE WHEN tab=13 AND rownum=20 THEN 'percent' WHEN tab IN(8,9) AND rownum=8 THEN 'USD/beneficial_unit' ELSE 'USD' END unit_ok
 FROM facts
)
SELECT count(*), count(*) FILTER(WHERE f->'value'='null'::jsonb),
bool_and(source_ok IS TRUE AND output_pin_ok IS TRUE AND offsets_ok IS TRUE AND cell_hashes_ok IS TRUE AND lexical_ok IS TRUE AND numeric_ok IS TRUE AND balance_period_ok IS TRUE AND unit_ok IS TRUE)
INTO positions,nulls,checks_pass FROM checked;
IF positions IS DISTINCT FROM 102 OR nulls IS DISTINCT FROM 8 OR checks_pass IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PBT_NATIVE_SOURCE_CELL_OR_SEMANTICS_CHANGED';END IF;
RETURN v_output;
END $pbt$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.financial_pbt_reviewed_source_v1() FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated;
